findings.details: The bootstrap's11 fixed literal replacements each match exactly once. Applying them to the fixed old driver yields the entire66896-byte postimage; reversing them restores all64804 old bytes. Complete supplied diff equals the recomputed diff.

Only authority_file and main differ. All26 other function ASTs remain identical, including original14 helpers, all7 resource functions and the original audit template/path logic. No Lean source, proof, guard or parser is modified.

The same fixed base/project must already exist. verification-import-order-resume-v3 must not exist and is created once after the original failure pins and initial resource checks. Duplicate invocation stops before owning or overwriting an existing evidence directory.

Old driver.py, INPUT_CONTRACT.json and FAILURE.json SHA256 are checked before writes. The failure must state no completed Lean stages, no supplier replay, and only the exact target source as partial target output. These original files are subsequently protected through preserve/stable and included under original-first-attempt/ in the success archive. The old verification directory is never the new output destination.

authority_file now accepts only a regular non-symlink cached authority under previous_out/original-authorities. It checks before/after stat and the exact pinned bytes/hash, then copies to the new evidence directory with exclusive creation. No get_blob or fallback exists in this function; a missing or altered cache fails and is recorded in the new attempt's FAILURE.json.

The normal-record member is read from its old captured path, stat/hash-bound, and copied only to the new evidence directory. Target source is read from its existing project path with fixed byte count/SHA/Git identity and is not rewritten. Neither cached old normal archive nor target source is fetched again. The unchanged R1 function consumes cached original authorities; no old Lean audit is rerun.

An existing project-object destination is accepted only if it is a symlink whose strict resolved target equals the exact existing supplied object. A regular existing destination is rejected. New links are created only at missing destinations; existing old objects are never replaced.

The original failure handler is unchanged. A failure after exclusive new-directory creation is written under that new directory; old evidence remains untouched. A bootstrap or prewrite failure has task stdout/traceback and creates no new evidence directory. No automatic retry or cache redownload is introduced.

The whole bootstrap has12 AST statements: fixed local old driver/contract reads, old SHA assertions,11 literal replacements, whole postimage SHA assertion, and exactly bound exec globals. The whole outer template has5 AST statements, exact decoded6266-byte bootstrap, bound observation data/SHA, and exact exec globals. It is3528bytes with no NUL.
